title: Zesty Rich Syrian Lamb Bake
description: A rich and flavorful Syrian dish featuring lamb, chilli flakes, and a blend of spices, perfect for a special occasion. This dish is gluten-free-friendly and offers a light and zesty taste.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together chilli flakes, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Return the lamb to the skillet and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the lamb for 20-25 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
